method: Actual sequential bilingual reading; mechanical checks do not substitute for prose review.

checks.summary: Read §1.1–1.9 with Theorem1.5 existence/uniqueness reductions, Lemmas1.6–1.8 proofs and first part1.7 lifting proof; begin Lemma1.10. Checked root/radicial distinctions, q≥0, all equivariance and multiplication formulas, footnotes. No confirmed mistranslation.

Read graded-algebra algebraization proof and diagram, §1.12 cohomological argument through Corollary1.21, Theorem2.1 and Proposition2.2 statements. Verified composition quotients, differentials and signs, centralizer/kernel, freeness bijection, noncommutativity on every fiber, pairing and Gauss product equivalence. No confirmed mistranslation.

Read Proposition2.2 A–D including full Lemma2.3 proof. Checked open-domain restrictions V,W,N,N′, all associativity equations1–6 and corrected substitutions, derivative arguments and positive-characteristic Frobenius formula. Chinese follows source; known F1(X^p^n)=F1(X)^p^n issue preserved. D cites hypothesis(ii) with inherited key sga3:xx:2.3:item:ii instead of Proposition2.2 hypothesis; preserve for semantic coordinator.

Read rest of Proposition2.2 E–G, Corollaries2.4–2.13, product formulas, principal-bundle pairing, coroot and infinitesimal relations, central quotient argument. All formulas, morphism domains, invertibility hypotheses, uniqueness and footnotes agree with translation.

Read Lemma2.14 native diagrams and Theorem3.1 all six assertions with full proof, Corollary3.2/Lemma3.3, Remark3.4 and §3.5. Checked all inverse/sign/pairing formulas and two long ordered products. Translation preserves source formulas; footnote exp(z^{-2}X) apparently missing X inverse remains inherited source issue.

Read Theorem3.6 all formulas/proof, Corollaries3.7–3.8, principal torsor diagram3.9, Lemma3.10 and Proposition3.11 equivalences/proof, Proposition3.12 open cell formula and proof. Checked contragredient maps, q-powers, directions and native diagrams. Repeated local-item reference drift inherited in source3.6–3.11, no keys guessed or changed.

Read complete isomorphism theorem4.1 proof, categorical interpretation4.2 and Corollaries4.3–4.4; §5.1–5.6 examples, line-bundle matrix groups/Lie algebras, elementary systems, exponentials and coroots, native diagrams and all editor footnotes. Translation faithful. §5.3 citation XIX1.6 is inherited; criterion candidate XIX1.11 from mathematical content, preserve until coordinator verification.

Read §5.7 diagrams, Proposition5.8 through equivalence theorem5.11, full §6 generators-and-relations theorem6.2 and both technical lemmas through Remark6.3/end, all notes. Checked quotient construction, maps f/g, closed subgroups, necessary/sufficient relations, all conjugations and algebraic substitutions. No additional confirmed Chinese mistranslation; no standalone bibliography in frozen XX.

Conjugation of exp(X^{-1}) written exp(z^{-2}X); final X appears to need inverse. Chinese follows frozen English; not silently fixed.

Source local (i)/(ii) keys drift to1.5,3.8,3.10. Semantic candidates are actual statement being proved; §5.3 XIX1.6 criterion plausibly XIX1.11. Preserve keys; coordinator to adjudicate exact targets.
